title: glyceria fluitans var. spicata
intro: Glyceria fluitans var. spicata, commonly known as Fluitans Glyceria or Floating Sweet Grass, is a type of aquatic grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria fluitans var. spicata include demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and soothing irritated tissues. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
